displayDescription.en:
Policy-based reinforcement learning needed a rigorous expression for how long-run performance changes with policy parameters. The policy gradient theorem supplied that expression without requiring derivatives of the environment dynamics.

The performance gradient can be written as an expectation of action-value estimates multiplied by the policy score. Actor-critic methods use a learned critic to estimate that value while the actor follows the resulting gradient. Experts generally treat the policy gradient theorem as the mathematical backbone of modern actor-critic and policy-optimization algorithms. PPO, natural policy gradients, deterministic policy gradients, and many RLHF methods inherit its structure.
displayDescription.zh:
基于策略的强化学习需要一个严格公式，说明长期性能如何随策略参数变化。策略梯度定理给出了这一表达式，而且不需要对环境动力学求导。

性能梯度可以写成动作价值估计与策略得分乘积的期望。Actor-critic 方法用学习到的 critic 估计价值，actor 则沿该梯度更新。专家通常把策略梯度定理视为现代 actor-critic 和策略优化算法的数学骨架。PPO、自然策略梯度、确定性策略梯度以及许多 RLHF 方法都继承了这一结构。
